basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Melbourne, Australia, I've been a part of the Reddit community for over seven years. By day, I work as a paralegal, engaging with international law and policies, which fuels my passion for understanding complex legal systems. By night, I indulge in my hobbies of gaming and animation, particularly drawn to the quirky and humorous style of SMG4. I’m a night owl, often online from 9 PM to 2 AM local time, when I can unwind from the day’s work. In a relationship for three years with a fellow animation enthusiast.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor’s degree in International Relations, which is where my interest in international law began. Over the years, I've self-taught myself various aspects of legal systems worldwide, primarily through online courses and avid reading. My love for animation and gaming comes from a childhood surrounded by cartoons and video games, which has grown into a deeper appreciation for digital art and storytelling.
